Messages.Author: Enkahel
Messages.Body:
Greetings everyone,

We are having an issue about how to define "an action" at our tables.
Here is the perfect example with Bum's Rush:

Bum's Rush, Action
Do not replace until the end of this action. (D) Enter combat with a
ready minion controlled by another Methuselah. The acting minion gets an
optional maneuver during this combat.

As the text says, the action is to "enter combat with". So, once I'm in
combat (with all the phases we know), and if I wasn't blocked, the
action is resolved because I HAVE just entered in combat. I am NOW in
combat. This would mean I replace my card (since the action of entering
combat has ended).

Some players say that there can't be any combat without an action, so
the combat implies the action, and so the card is replaced after combat.

Who's right here?

Regards
--
Enkahel

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


The action is not over until all of its effects (including all combats
that result, whether from the action itself or any blocks) are over.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
witness1 wrote:
> The action is not over until all of its effects (including all combats
> that result, whether from the action itself or any blocks) are over.

Correct. In combat, you are resolving the Bum's Rush action. The action isn't
yet over.

Like when you put a turkey in the oven, you are cooking. Putting in the turkey
doesn't mean you've finished cooking (just that you've finished prepping the
turkey for the oven).

And, if there are any additional combats to be done (from Psyche! or Fast
Reaction, for example), they're also handled during the action (before the end
of the action).

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
On May 1, 8:37 am, Enkahel <enkahel@goth_your_mail.invalid> wrote:
> Greetings everyone,

Greetings as well!

> We are having an issue about how to define "an action" at our tables.
> Here is the perfect example with Bum's Rush:

An action is defined as from teh monment that the acting vampire is
tapped until the action resolves, whether through an unblocked action
being successful or through the end of combat or both, if the action
was to enter combat.

> Bum's Rush, Action
> Do not replace until the end of this action. (D) Enter combat with a
> ready minion controlled by another Methuselah. The acting minion gets an
> optional maneuver during this combat.
>
> As the text says, the action is to "enter combat with". So, once I'm in
> combat (with all the phases we know), and if I wasn't blocked, the
> action is resolved because I HAVE just entered in combat. I am NOW in
> combat. This would mean I replace my card (since the action of entering
> combat has ended).

No, the action is not resolved until all combats are concluded.

> Some players say that there can't be any combat without an action, so
> the combat implies the action, and so the card is replaced after combat.

Those players would be correct.

> Who's right here?

The Bum's Rush is not replaced until after the last combat (in the
case of multiple combats).
